mechanism: Isotretinoin is highly teratogenic and ceftriaxone may alter gut flora affecting enterohepatic recirculation of isotretinoin, potentially increasing systemic exposure; additionally, both drugs require careful monitoring in pregnancy contexts.
action: Ensure robust contraception in females of childbearing potential taking isotretinoin; monitor for isotretinoin efficacy and toxicity if ceftriaxone is co-administered; counsel on timing of administration.
